question: How do the five powers generate scriptural form from manifesting reality?
premises: The five powers are consciousness, vibration, will, knowledge, and action.
They operate according to their own appropriateness.
Through the grace of the five Brahman-limbs they give rise to awareness of flashing aspects of being.
inference: The five powers, by their own appropriateness and the five Brahman-limbs, generate the awareness that becomes scriptural form.
uncertainties: vidā in the compound is read as knowledge (jñāna/vidyā) in this technical context.
plain_english: In those five powers whose forms are consciousness, vibration, will, knowledge, and action, by the force of their own appropriateness and through the grace of the five Brahman-limbs, there arises what is born from the awareness of the flashing aspects of being.
